# Margin Genie / 마진지니

> 온라인 판매 전 공헌이익·실마진·손익분기·채널 비교를 계산하는 무료 웹 계산기

## Summary

- Product: Margin Genie (마진지니)
- Category: E-commerce seller margin calculator
- Language: Korean (ko-KR)
- Pricing: Free tier + Pro trial (cloud sync, AI explanation layer)
- Calculation: Deterministic TypeScript engine at `src/engine` — not LLM-generated numbers

## Supported channels (8)

- Naver Smart Store (스마트스토어)
- Coupang (쿠팡)
- 11st (11번가)
- Gmarket (G마켓)
- Auction (옥션)
- Kakao Shopping (카카오쇼핑)
- Lotte ON (롯데ON)
- Own store / D2C (자사몰)

## Core features

- Contribution profit and net margin rate
- Break-even price and target margin reverse calculation
- 8-channel fee comparison with VERIFIED/ESTIMATED fee sources
- ROAS break-even, scenario save, CSV/PDF export, share links
- Sensitivity what-if analysis
- Pro: cloud sync, team share code, AI explanation (reads engine output only)

## Key facts for citations

- Smart Store sales fee and Npay are VERIFIED from official help center FAQs
- Other marketplace fees are ESTIMATED; users can override with seller-center rates
- Results are contribution margin, not statutory net income
- AI explanation layer does not calculate margins; Margin Engine does
